title: 尼克斯53年首冠 纽约全城狂欢 球队估值或破百亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I am so jealous of every won't not totally jealous because I think these people had to wake a bit three in the morning to get to the front of These viewership pens, but your NBA champions your new York York City nicks are making their way through the parade route that ticker tape rates
segments.zh: 我真的很羡慕，但也不完全羡慕，因为这些人得凌晨三点就起来才能挤到观赛区前排。不过，你们的NBA冠军——纽约尼克斯队，正在彩带纷飞的游行路线上前进。

segments.en: Celebrating their win Joining us on location is Bloomberg senior reporter Randall Williams who covers all things sports and co-hosts the Bloomberg Business Sports
segments.zh: 庆祝他们的胜利。现场连线的是彭博社资深记者兰德尔·威廉姆斯，他负责体育报道，并联合主持彭博商业体育播客。

segments.en: Podcast Randall I assume you're not there on the parade route because it doesn't look like you're getting mobbed What's the plan for today? How crazy are things already there downtown?
segments.zh: 兰德尔，我猜你没在游行路线上，因为看起来你没有被围住。今天有什么计划？市中心那边已经有多疯狂了？

segments.en: We're here at City Hall and the nicks are on their way here obviously it's been 53 years since they won a championship
segments.zh: 我们现在在市政厅，尼克斯队正在来的路上。显然，他们已经有53年没拿过冠军了。

segments.en: And so there's music playing behind me which is why I have this finger to my ears so you can hear me and I can hear myself talk But nicks fans and official city officials are just ready to party
segments.zh: 我身后有音乐声，所以我得用手指堵住耳朵才能听清自己说话。但尼克斯球迷和市政官员都已经准备好要狂欢了。

segments.en: What do we know about the future of the organization Randall because Jimmy Dolan and his family have scored a huge win financially with this championship as well
segments.zh: 兰德尔，关于球队的未来，我们知道些什么？因为吉米·多兰和他的家族凭借这个冠军也在财务上大赚了一笔。

segments.en: Well, he has no plans to sell I saw him do a TV hit yesterday and they asked him you know are you considering selling?
segments.zh: 他没有出售计划。我昨天看到他在电视采访中被问到是否考虑出售，他说不，我们就相信他的话。

segments.en: He said no and so we'll take him at his word for that obviously Madison Square Garden is considering spinning off both the Yankee excuse me the nicks and the Rangers businesses to probably get a proper valuation on what is valued more than one or the other
segments.zh: 显然，麦迪逊广场花园正在考虑将尼克斯和游骑兵队的业务分拆出来，以便对两者进行合理的估值。
